newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sembawang Maritime, CWT in Dubai joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Sembawang Maritime, CWT in Dubai joint venture.

text.p: Sembawang Maritime Ltd (SML) and CWT Distribution Ltd said on Monday they had teamed up with Arab businessman Ali Albwardy to offer warehousing and distribution services in Dubai.
The companies said in a joint statement the agreement gave CWT a 40 percent stake of a new joint venture firm, CWT-SML Logistics LLC. SML and Albwardy would each hold 30 percent.
The statement said the warehousing facilities would be in the Free Trade Zone of Dubai's Jebel Ali Port and be operational by the first half of 1998.
SML said the initial investment in the project was expected to be around US$3 million.
